subject: Emotions
title: Gaslighting
description: A short lesson to help you apply Gaslighting.

hook.text: He says: 'That never happened.' She remembers it clearly but starts doubting her own memory. She's being gaslit.

buildup.text: The term comes from a 1944 film where a husband manipulates his wife into thinking she's going insane.

discovery.text: Gaslighting weaponizes emotional perception: the abuser reads the victim's insecurities and exploits self-doubt.

twist.text: Victims often have high empathy. They try to understand the abuser's perspective, which makes them more susceptible.

climax.text: Recovery requires external validation: trusted friends, therapists, and journals that prove memory isn't failing.

punchline.text: If someone makes you doubt your own reality, the problem isn't your reality.
